title: Phase 6: Publish mdatron 0.1.0 to crates.io + vsdd CI migration
description:
v0.1.0 release gate.

Scope: (1) crates.io publish for mdatron (after Phases 0-4 land; Phase 5 optional). (2) vsdd-cli/.github/workflows/mdatron-verify.yml migrated: cargo install mdatron --locked --version 0.1.x replaces sibling-checkout. (3) templates/.github/workflows/vsdd-verify.yml similarly updated. (4) vsdd-cli/.githooks/pre-commit install hint switches to cargo install mdatron --locked. (5) README install instructions updated for both repos. (6) CHANGELOG entries for both repos.

Acceptance: cargo install mdatron --locked --version 0.1.0 works in clean environment; vsdd-cli CI passes against published crate (sibling repo no longer required for build); pre-commit hook activates without local cargo install --path.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 6. Blocked by Phases 2 + 3 + 4 (and 5 if shipping in v0.1.0). Supersedes existing issue #9 (path-dep migration).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED — all six scope items discharged: (1) crates.io publish done upstream (0.5.0; mdatron GH #1 closed as fulfilled); (2) mdatron-verify.yml on the pinned registry install (PR #21); (3) adopter template likewise (PR #21); (4) pre-commit hint switched (PR #21); (5) README install instruction switched — PR #22 CI-GREEN (verify 10s on the cached binary), MERGE IS THE OPERATOR'S MANUAL STEP per the git-mutation restriction that activated during close-out; (6) CHANGELOG delegated to crosslink, intentional. The version outran the title: 0.1.0 planned, 0.5.0 delivered.
